title: Shinrai Ou — Throne of Thunder
revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Storm classification / forked tree

classification.selector: jutsu classification: the qualifying element(s), whatever the jutsu's source
classification.applies_to: matching supported tags on all Storm jutsu
not_selectors: equipment / required bloodline item (castability gate only)
classification.off_kit_coverage: unverified (no non-bloodline jutsu catalog with effect rows in the repository)

emphasis.primary: Damage (Burst: Vajra Tempering charges the Storm Cloak and Raijin self buffs, then Thunder King's Wrath pays off with +2 Damage on all four Storm attacks)
emphasis.secondary: Increase Damage Taken (Izanagi's Hammer area exposure, +10% route, ×1.074) and Reflect (Indra's Storm Cloak retaliation, +10% route)
emphasis.tertiary: Increase Damage Given (Mandate of Thunder and the Burst setup; three compounding rows held at +4%)
emphasis.rationale: Shinrai Ou is a rank-A Burst kit whose four Storm attacks are 50, 45, 40 and 40 EP (60 AP, cooldown 7). The pre-batch +5 Damage route took Daibutsu Thunder to 55, Railgun to 50 and both 40s up a tier. Burst now follows the Blood-Enchanted Eyes pattern instead: Vajra Tempering sets up by charging the three compounding self buffs (two on the 40 AP Storm Cloak, one on Raijin), and Thunder King's Wrath pays off with a controlled +2 Damage (50 → 52, 45 → 47, 40 → 42). Mandate of Thunder answers "How do I make my thunder land harder: charge myself or expose them?" with Burst and with Judgement from Above's Hammer exposure (+10%, 35 → 45%, ×1.074). Raiment of Storms answers "How do I make attackers pay for striking me?" with the Cloak's Reflect (+10%). Potency reaches matching supported tags on all Storm jutsu (RUL-2026-10-03-005).

nodes.name: Mandate of Thunder
nodes.flavor: Heaven names its king in thunder; the storm answers before the title is spoken.
nodes.coverage_note: Storm Cloak Increase Damage Given rows 0 and 2 and Raijin's 35 → 37% (self, 2 rounds); Hammer exposure 35 → 37% (area enemies, 2 rounds).

nodes.name: Vajra Tempering
nodes.flavor: The king's own storm tempers the thunderbolt, again and again, until nothing it strikes stays standing.
nodes.coverage_note: Burst setup: Storm Cloak Increase Damage Given rows 0 and 2 and Raijin's self buff 37 → 39% with Mandate of Thunder (self, 2 rounds); the three rows compound on a hit inside both windows.

nodes.name: Thunder King's Wrath
nodes.flavor: When the king's patience ends, the sky itself is the weapon.
nodes.coverage_note: Burst payoff: +2 Damage on all four Storm attacks: Daibutsu Thunder 50 → 52 (past the 50 Nuke tier; director precedent), Divine Railgun 45 → 47, Izanagi's Hammer and Strike: Raijin 40 → 42 EP. No other tier is crossed.

nodes.name: Lightning Rod
nodes.flavor: Mark the foe as the tallest thing on the field and let the storm choose.
nodes.coverage_note: Hammer exposure row only: +3% (40% with Mandate of Thunder) on Lightning/None/Storm/Water hits against enemies on its spiral tiles, 2 rounds after the cast.

nodes.name: Judgement from Above
nodes.flavor: The exposed are not struck once; every bolt that follows finds them first.
nodes.coverage_note: Exposure: Hammer 35 → 45% Increase Damage Taken on the full route (+10%, ×1.074 per matching hit, Shakunetsu Sakura's two-row ×1.075), on every enemy on its spiral tiles for 2 rounds; allies' matching hits gain too.

nodes.name: Raiment of Storms
nodes.flavor: A cloak of living lightning: it bites whoever touches it.
nodes.coverage_note: Storm Cloak Reflect 40 → 42% (self, 2 rounds, all four stat types).

nodes.name: Galvanic Rebuke
nodes.flavor: Strike the storm and the storm strikes back, charge for charge.
nodes.coverage_note: Storm Cloak Reflect row only: +3% (45% with Raiment of Storms; pierce included, 60% cap); 40 AP self cast, cooldown 7, 2 rounds.

nodes.name: Thunder Answers Thunder
nodes.flavor: Every blow against the king is a confession, and the sky passes sentence.
nodes.coverage_note: Retaliation: Storm Cloak Reflect 40 → 50% on the full route (+10%), ten points under the 60% per-hit cap.

examples.name: Thunder King's Wrath
examples.rationale: Vajra Tempering charges the Cloak and Raijin self buffs to 39% (+4% with Mandate of Thunder), and Thunder King's Wrath pays off with +2 Damage: Daibutsu Thunder 50 → 52 (past the Nuke tier, director precedent), Divine Railgun 45 → 47, Hammer and Raijin 40 → 42 EP. A Daibutsu Thunder landing inside both buff windows is about ×1.14 stronger than the unmodified kit's (52/50 × 1.39³/1.35³), before the bloodline passive. Lightning Rod is the strongest fourth (Hammer exposure 40%; ×1.18 on that Daibutsu Thunder with the exposure also live, under Blood-Enchanted Eyes' ×1.234 top package); Raiment of Storms (Reflect 42%) is the alternative.

examples.name: Judgement from Above
examples.rationale: Hammer's area Increase Damage Taken reaches 45% (+10%), live in the two rounds after Hammer's cast on every enemy on its spiral tiles and never on Hammer's own hit, so every matching Storm, Lightning, Water or element-less hit on them lands ×1.074 harder (Shakunetsu Sakura's two-row ×1.075), allies' included. Vajra Tempering is the strongest fourth (self buffs 37 → 39%; ×1.17 with the three self buffs and the exposure live, the tree's top percentage package); Raiment of Storms (Reflect 42%) suits a player who expects to be focused rather than one chasing damage.

examples.name: Thunder Answers Thunder
examples.rationale: Indra's Storm Cloak reflects 50% of every hit the caster takes in the two rounds after its cast (+10%), bypassing shields and ten points under the 60% per-hit cap. Mandate of Thunder is the only closed fourth purchase (the universal node; see the narrow-kit exception) and adds +2% to the self buffs and Hammer's exposure (37%).

narrow_kit_exception: Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four, the same shape as before the batch. The kit has four supported tags on nine rows (Damage x4, Increase Damage Given x3, Increase Damage Taken x1, Reflect x1), and each Advanced Art owns one idea: burst (self-charge setup into +2 Damage), exposure (Hammer) and retaliation (the Cloak's Reflect). A fourth capstone would twin one of them: a pure Increase Damage Given route would reuse Vajra Tempering's three compounding rows, whose compounding holds them to about +5%, so it would be Burst without its payoff; a second exposure or Reflect route would split a single row; a second Damage route would repeat the 50 → 52 payoff. Mandate of Thunder forks into Burst and Exposure and Raiment of Storms carries the single Reflect chain, so Mandate of Thunder is a universal node (in all 8 legal full builds): Raiment's 3-BP chain needs a fourth purchase and Mandate is the only prerequisite-closed one. A Hidden Art leaf under Raiment would be filler: a Reflect leaf lifts Reflect past +10%, an Increase Damage Given leaf is a one-point sliver or, with Vajra Tempering, pushes the three compounding rows past +5%, an exposure leaf twins Lightning Rod, and a Damage leaf puts flat Damage on a Hidden Art. Burst and Exposure each keep two fourth-purchase choices; Retaliation has one.
design_notes: Damage: Thunder King's Wrath is the only Damage node (+2), so every legal allocation ends at Daibutsu Thunder 50 → 52, Divine Railgun 45 → 47 and Izanagi's Hammer and Strike: Raijin 40 → 42 EP, or adds no flat Damage. 52 is past the 50 Nuke tier under the Blood-Enchanted Eyes and Shakunetsu Sakura precedent (see above_nuke_rationale); no other row changes tier, and the pre-batch +5 route (50 → 55, 45 → 50, 40 → 45) stays retired. Maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +2, Increase Damage Given +4%, Increase Damage Taken +10%, Reflect +10%.

Increase Damage Given leverage: both Cloak rows match the kit's Storm hits (row 0 via its Highest stat filter, row 2 via Storm) and compound with Raijin's row, so each point counts two or three times on one hit: at the +4% maximum the Cloak alone goes ×1.35² ≈ ×1.82 → ×1.39² ≈ ×1.93 and all three ×2.46 → ×2.69 (×1.09). This is one of the roster's two fastest three-row stacks (Cloak 40 AP plus Raijin 60 AP in one 100 AP turn, no item gate), so it stays below the +5% that slower three-row stacks hold. The bloodline passive (25 + 0.15/lvl) multiplies last. The buffs also reach normal jutsu and weapons (row 0 and Raijin: Highest-stat or element-less hits; row 2: Storm, Lightning, Water or element-less).

Fourth purchases: Burst (01, 02, 03: +4% IDG, +2% IDT, +2 Damage) takes Lightning Rod (Hammer exposure 40%) or Raiment of Storms (Reflect 42%); Exposure (01, 04, 05: +2% IDG, +10% IDT) takes Vajra Tempering (self buffs 39%) or Raiment of Storms; Retaliation (06, 07, 08) takes only Mandate of Thunder. In an all-windows-live model (three IDG rows and Hammer exposure; flat Damage counted on Daibutsu Thunder as 52/50) Burst's package is about ×1.15 and ×1.18 with Lightning Rod (×1.132 × 1.04); Exposure's is ×1.12 and ×1.17 with Vajra Tempering, the tree's top percentage package, and its exposure also lifts allies' hits. Burst sits just under Blood-Enchanted Eyes' Rite of Exsanguination route (×1.149 plus Reaper's Embrace 50 → 52 ≈ ×1.19), and every package stays under Blood-Enchanted Eyes' ×1.234 top package. No capstone shares a tag with its sibling Hidden Art, and the Vajra setup is a self buff that does not feed Lightning Rod's mark.

Exposure magnitude: Judgement from Above's +10% sits on one area row (Hammer 35 → 45%), so a hit on an exposed enemy gains ×1.45/1.35 ≈ ×1.074, the same compounded lift as Shakunetsu Sakura's +5% on two exposure rows (×1.40²/1.35² ≈ ×1.075) and under Blood-Enchanted Eyes' ×1.115 exposure maximum.

Uptime: cooldown 7 on all five jutsu (attacks 60 AP, Cloak 40 AP). Each buff and the exposure is live only in the two rounds after its cast, never on its own jutsu's hit, so the +2 Damage payoff lands inside the self-buff windows when the Cloak or Raijin is cast first. The Cloak and Raijin buffs land on the caster at cast time; Hammer's exposure is a ground effect on its spiral around the caster, re-applied to enemies standing there.

Reflect and untouched rows: the Cloak Reflect row lists all four stat types and no element, so it matches effectively every hit the caster takes; the return bypasses shields, and other Reflect sources add to it up to the 60%-of-hit cap. Daibutsu's recoil 40%, Railgun's stun 100 and the two move rows are unsupported and unchanged; the bloodline passives (Increase Damage Given; 15% Decrease Damage Taken against Lightning) are not potency targets.
risks: Classification: Storm is the single qualifying element; sharing it with Arashima, Godstorm Eclipse and Stormboat Willy is expected (RUL-2026-10-03-005). 6 of 9 kit rows carry Storm; the Cloak Reflect row and two of the three Increase Damage Given rows (Cloak row 0, Raijin) are element-less, so Retaliation and most of the Burst setup need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver. Off-kit Storm coverage is unverified.

Damage tier: Thunder King's Wrath lifts Daibutsu Thunder 50 → 52, above the 50 Nuke tier, as a controlled payoff under the RUL-2026-10-04-001/002 precedent, kept for the dossier's Burst trait; it needs director confirmation (DQ-A). Off-kit Storm attacks also gain +2 Damage.

Increase Damage Given stacking: with both Cloak rows and Raijin live, a matching hit is ×1.39³ ≈ ×2.69 at the +4% maximum before the bloodline passive multiplies, and a 52 EP Daibutsu Thunder in both windows is about ×1.14 the unmodified kit's. Each row stays far below the 100 cap, but the combined amplification was not simulated against peer kits.
Exposure: Hammer's area Increase Damage Taken reaches 45% at the route maximum (×1.074 per matching hit) on every enemy on its tiles, and allies' matching hits on them gain too. Not simulated.

Reflect: other Reflect sources add to the Cloak's 50% and could saturate the 60%-of-pre-shield-damage cap. Reflect pays only when the caster is hit in the two rounds after the Cloak's cast, and the kit has no Decrease Damage Taken row to pair it with.

Universal node: Mandate of Thunder is in all 8 legal full-budget builds because the Retaliation chain has no other prerequisite-closed fourth purchase, so a Retaliation player always takes +2% Increase Damage Given / Increase Damage Taken. Accepted under the narrow-kit exception.

Delivery: Daibutsu Thunder (radius-1 spawn on an OTHER_USER target), Raijin (ground circle spawn) and Hammer (spiral around the caster) are area deliveries; realized hits and exposure depend on positioning. Every harmful row is friendly fire ENEMIES, so no ally hazards. Skill-tree effects are off in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING; no combat simulation was performed.

audit.revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Storm classification / forked tree
limits: Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).

Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Storm jutsu. Off-kit jutsu of the element are in scope by rule; their count is unverified. Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.
Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.
Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.
Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.

Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.
Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.
No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.
Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit.

above_nuke_rationale: Fable proposal following the director precedent of Blood-Enchanted Eyes (RUL-2026-10-04-001) and Shakunetsu Sakura (RUL-2026-10-04-002). Kit fact: the dossier's Traits line is Burst, and Storm Style: Daibutsu Thunder is the kit's strongest strike (rank A, 50 EP, 60 AP, cooldown 7). Thunder King's Wrath's controlled +2 Damage, the payoff of the Vajra Tempering percentage setup (+2% Increase Damage Given on the Cloak and Raijin self buffs), lifts Daibutsu Thunder 50 → 52, past the 50 Nuke tier. It is the tree's only Damage node and an Advanced Art, so no allocation without it exceeds 50 and none exceeds +2 (Divine Railgun 45 → 47, Izanagi's Hammer and Strike: Raijin 40 → 42; no other tier crossed). Flagged for director confirmation (DQ-A).

foundation_sentences.01: How do I make my thunder land harder: charge myself or expose them?
foundation_sentences.06: How do I make attackers pay for striking me?

route_identities.03: burst: self-charge setup on the Hidden Art, controlled +2 Damage payoff on all four Storm attacks
route_identities.05: exposure: Hammer marks each enemy on its spiral tiles; every matching hit on the marked target lands harder, allies' included
route_identities.08: retaliation: the Storm Cloak returns half of every blow

design_review.director_review: Roster questions: DQ-A (Thunder King's Wrath +2 Damage after the Vajra Tempering setup, Storm Style: Daibutsu Thunder 50 → 52, kept for the dossier's Burst trait; see above_nuke_rationale); DQ-B (Judgement from Above +10% Increase Damage Taken on 1 row: Izanagi's Hammer 35 → 45%; ≈ ×1.074, against Shakunetsu Sakura ×1.075 and Blood-Enchanted Eyes ×1.115).
concerns: Thunder King's Wrath's +2 Damage lifts Daibutsu Thunder 50 → 52, past the Nuke tier, under the Blood-Enchanted Eyes / Shakunetsu Sakura precedent; kept because the dossier's Traits line is Burst (DQ-A).

The three-row Increase Damage Given stack is one of the roster's two fastest (one 100 AP turn, no item gate), so it is held at +4% (×1.09 on a hit inside both buff windows), below the +5% of slower stacks. With the Damage payoff and Lightning Rod the Burst package is about ×1.18 on Daibutsu Thunder in an all-windows-live model, just under Blood-Enchanted Eyes' Rite of Exsanguination route (≈ ×1.19) and under its ×1.234 top package.

Judgement from Above is single-row area team exposure at +10% (Hammer 35 → 45%, ×1.074 per matching hit), the same compounded lift as Shakunetsu Sakura's Conflagration in Bloom (×1.075) and under Blood-Enchanted Eyes' ×1.115 exposure maximum; a primary exposure route at +7% or more is roster question DQ-B.
Mandate of Thunder is universal, so the Retaliation route's fourth purchase is forced; the kit has no second defensive tag for a leaf under Raiment of Storms.
The Reflect row and two of the three Increase Damage Given rows are element-less and depend on the proposed jutsu-classification resolver.
